Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue improve?
Choices:
A) A specific workflow or script: name it in your answer, for example `review_autofix.yml` or `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` (RECOMMENDED)
B) Documentation only (`README.md`, `docs/`, `agents.d/` fragments)
C) Test coverage or CI speed (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `tests/`)
D) Prompt templates under `prompts/`
Q2: What kind of "better" is wanted?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure: give the run ID, PR, issue or error text (RECOMMENDED)
B) Reduce cost or runtime (fewer model calls, fewer GitHub API calls, faster jobs)
C) Better reliability or observability (retries, alerts, log prefixes)
D) New behaviour or a new feature: describe the expected outcome
Q3: How will we know the work is done?
Choices:
A) A concrete, testable outcome you state in your answer, for example "run X no longer fails with Y" (RECOMMENDED)
B) A measurable target: name the metric and its threshold
C) No acceptance criteria; close this issue and file a specific one instead
